message: XVatsim 1.0.2 is available. Download the update from X-Plane.org.
release_notes: Fixed missed airway route sector resolution when an expanded FMS route is available.
Added unresolved airway diagnostics so incomplete airway routes no longer collapse into an exact direct route.
Kept route-relevant enroute controllers visible during short AFV radio-range refresh gaps.
Moved frequency ordering, Active row ownership, and Standby Assist target selection under brain ownership.
Added notify-only in-plugin update checks with manual Check for Updates and 24-hour automatic cadence.
